verdict.rationale: Insomnia's core is an Apache-2.0 open-source client ([insomnia-gh-3]) that can keep data entirely under the user's control. Projects can use Local Vault or Git Sync to any third-party repository without going through the cloud, and Kong does not host that data ([insomnia-gh-1], [insomnia-docs-44], [insomnia-docs-32]). Mock servers can be self-hosted via Insomnia Mockbin ([insomnia-docs-57]), and the Scratch Pad needs no login ([insomnia-docs-31]). missing for 10: evidence that the collaboration backend (organizations, RBAC, Cloud Sync) can be self-hosted, documented self-hosting/build-from-source deployment guidance, and independent hands-on corroboration.
